text_blocks.snippet: The Public Provident Fund (PPF) interest rate in India is 7.1% per annum for the current quarter (July through September 2026 / Q2 of FY 2026–27).

list.snippet: Interest Rate: 7.1% per annum, compounded annually.
Review Cycle: The Government of India reviews and announces the rate every quarter.
Interest Calculation: Calculated monthly on the lowest balance in your account between the 5th day and the end of the month.
Lock-in Period: 15 years (with options to extend in blocks of 5 years).
Tax Status: Exempt-Exempt-Exempt (EEE) — investments under Section 80C, interest earned, and maturity proceeds are all completely tax-free.
